scene_summary: Landscape watercolor or dye plate on a flat sage-green ground. On the left, three dripping blot heads huddle together: an orange one at top left, a cream skull-like one with teal eye sockets at front, and a magenta one in the center. Each has a spiky green calyx and dark eye smudges. Lavender and violet drip streaks fall from the heads into a purple pool along the bottom edge. A teal hooked swoosh arcs across the upper middle-right. Small green star shapes and pairs of dark dots float in the open green space. There is no text.

effect_material.observation: Wet-bloomed dye pigment with feathered, fractal edges soaked into a flat matte ground. There are no glossy, reflective, or layered physical surfaces.

effect_editorial.source_observation: The image is a portrait-format painted artwork with no text, logos, UI, buttons or call to action. It shows eight saturated blots that bleed and drip in orange, magenta, teal, violet and yellow on a flat muted sage-green ground, set in a loose staggered grid. The pigment has feathered edges and vertical drip streaks, which suggests a wet watercolor, ink or dye technique. Several blots have leafy green tops and dark eye- or mouth-like marks, so they read as melting fruit, pumpkin or face hybrids that fit a spooky theme. The work is visible in the pixels themselves, so this is a creative artwork, not a product or administrative image. The caption's collection launch, VVV platform and holder terms are untrusted promotional claims that I did not verify. The saved note describes 'anime-style heads', which overstates what is visible: the forms are abstract drip-painted, face-like blots.

Left of center, three dye-blot heads huddle: orange pumpkin, cream skull-ghost with teal eye-sockets, magenta tomato, each with green star calyx and dark eye band. Lavender-violet drips pool at bottom edge. Teal hooked swoosh arcs free. No text.
